notes.title: Grey Instinct Progress Update - June 2023
notes.notes:
Hello all, we hope your 2023 has been going well so far! We are very happy with the positive reception with the Part 2 announcement and we cannot wait to release it for all of you to play! Unfortunately with that we have 2 items of bad news to share (do not worry, Part 2 is still being worked on). 

The first and biggest bad news is that Part 2 is being delayed to sometime in 2024. When we first finished Part 1 we estimated how long we believed it would take us to make 3 more chapters with much more content than Part 1 had and our estimated landed in mid 2023. This estimate has turned out to be incorrect due to our underestimation of how long larger and more content filled levels would take, some unexpected life events, and some legal troubles we will address in bad news item 2. We are crushed that the game is being delayed and we are sure you all are too. However, we are doing this so we can launch the best version of Part 2 that we can and live up to our own expectations and hopefully to all of the fans of Part 1's expectations. While understandably disappointed, we hope you all will be patient for Part 2 and celebrate with us when it releases next year.

The second item of bad news is the legal trouble mentioned above. As we are preparing for Part 2 launch and setting up the legal stuff around that we submitted trademarks for Grey Instinct and our studio 'Angry Bunny'. During that process Rovio Entertainment issued a trademark dispute against 'Angry Bunny' and even though we think we are in the right for naming our studio that, we cannot compete with them in the court of law about it since we do not have the vast financial support Rovio does. Because of this we are changing the studio name from 'Angry Bunny' to 'Plain Cheeseburger Games'. The store page, game, and the other various places that reference 'Angry Bunny' will be updated in the coming months. It is still the same people from 'Angry Bunny' now called 'Plain Cheeseburger Games' so do not worry about someone else working on Grey Instinct. That will always be us and we will work hard until it is complete.

Thank you all for the support over the years and your understanding for our current situations. We cannot wait to share what we have been working on and have all of you play it.

Thank you for playing,

Plain Cheeseburger Games

notes.title: Update for 7/23 - Microwave edition
notes.notes:
The bug causing the microwave scene to freeze and be unusable after clicking the "Start" button with a time of 0:00 has been fixed! Previous save files stuck on that moment should still work properly so no need to restart!

Thanks for playing!

Angry Bunny

notes.title: Update for 7/23
notes.notes:
A small patch to address a bug surrounding the VIP room and players being brought to a black screen after leaving the vending machine. This should now be fixed. 

When loading your save if it brings you to the vending machine make sure to switch between the upper and lower view of the vending machine at least once before trying to go back to the VIP room. If your save loads you to a black screen unfortunately you will have to make a new save. Sorry for any inconvenience!

Thanks for playing!

Angry Bunny
